title: Reconcile add-only CI egress drift automatically
body:
Operator 2026-10-29 granted: the self-hosted CI fleet automatically and atomically reconciles egress chain drift only when the drift adds DROP rules for a new host interface prefix (for example ham0 25/8), with a journal entry; loosening or foreign rules keep the current refusal. Stops on 2026-10-27 (about 2 h) and 2026-10-28 (3 h 41 min) came from configure-network.mjs refusing add-only drift.
Acceptance: configure-network --apply reconciles add-only DROP drift and still refuses any other drift; live-boundary checks run after reconciliation; tests prove both paths; delivered by a GLOBAL PR and deployed by the final native install, with no manual firewall change.
